docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Jean Valjean's pursuit by Javert across the France of 1815 to 1832.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Victor Hugo (1802–1885), Les Misérables (1862, French), translated by Isabel F. Hapgood (1851–1928), 1887. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
